title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who phases through Oba's roots, fights her, and is thrown back into the crumbling manor.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: An Agency detective who accuses Trostani and draws out Oba's confession, then grieves Etrata.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir assassin who defends Teysa's memory and takes a root spear meant for Yarus.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young Agency investigator hurled into the sky by Oba and saved by fae magic.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The archon head of the Agency, pinned by roots and freed by Kaya.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros guild leader who tries to arrest Oba.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: The Azorius head, pinned by roots.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: The Simic leader who reveals Zegana was seeking a cure for phyresis with her consent.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet guild leader who fights Oba with lightning.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: The Rakdos representative who flees the fight and is confronted by Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A Gruul centaur who charges Oba, declaring he never accepted her authority.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin accused of hoarding supplies during the invasion and selling them at inflated prices.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A Rakdos assassin who slips her chain and attacks Judith.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: A Golgari leader who withers Oba's vines with poison.

entities.name: Tolsimir
entities.description: A Selesnya elf who leaps in to protect Oba and is impaled on a rafter.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The tripart dryad of Vitu-Ghazi, split when Oba separates from her sisters.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The dryad of life who confesses to weeks of killings and, drawing on the Worldsoul, turns Vitu-Ghazi against the guild leaders.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: The dryad of order, Oba's sister, who pleads for her to be healed.

entities.name: Cim
entities.description: The dryad of harmony, Oba's sister, who pleads for her to be healed.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The murdered Orzhov leader whom Oba calls a traitor and Etrata calls a hero who spied on the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A murdered Simic figure who studied Phyrexian oil to cure phyresis.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: An Izzet inventor killed because he was in an assassin's path.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Worldsoul of Ravnica whose power Oba draws on.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A friend on Kaldheim whose roar Kaya recalls.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya guildhall that Oba reshapes into a killing box.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A Phyrexian design whose corruption Oba says she fought alone.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: A Phyrexian substance that Zegana studied and Oba says soaked Ravnica.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: The spreading taint of Phyrexia that Zegana sought to cure.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild of Trostani and Tolsimir.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The investigators led by Ezrim.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Aurelia's guild.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Lavinia's guild.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The spy guild that Teysa secretly worked with.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: Judith's and Massacre Girl's guild.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild for which Yarus dares to fight.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders blamed for Ravnica's ills.

events.summary: The room is stunned by Proft's accusation that Trostani is the killer and Ezrim asks Kaya if she knew.
events.quote: Ezrim looked to Kaya.

events.summary: Tolsimir insists Trostani cannot have done it because she cannot leave the healing tree.
events.quote: she can't leave Vitu-Ghazi while the tree is healing!

events.summary: Proft argues that Ravnica has been blaming Phyrexia for crimes it was capable of itself.
events.quote: It's become easy, in the aftermath of war, to blame everything on the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Oba breaks her calm and admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it.
events.quote: Because they deserved it

events.summary: Oba justifies the killings by claiming to be the heart of Ravnica betrayed by its guilds.
events.quote: We are the green and growing heart of this plane, and without us, there would be no Ravnica, no city, no guilds!

events.summary: Oba says she took the corruption of Realmbreaker into herself during the invasion.
events.quote: I fought the corruption of Realmbreaker alone.

events.summary: Oba accuses Krenko of hoarding and price-gouging during the invasion.
events.quote: was hoarding resources

events.summary: Oba accuses Zegana of experimenting with Phyrexian oil on ordinary creatures.
events.quote: Zegana was fascinated by the Phyrexian oil.

events.summary: Oba claims Teysa was in league with the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Teysa Karlov was in league with the Phyrexians, communicating with them in secret.

events.summary: Vannifar reveals Zegana was seeking a cure for phyresis with her consent.
events.quote: She was seeking a cure for phyresis, the spreading taint of Phyrexia

events.summary: Etrata reveals Teysa secretly spied on the Phyrexians for the resistance, working with House Dimir.
events.quote: She was working with House Dimir the whole time

events.summary: Krenko admits goblins died to get the supplies and he profited.
events.quote: Goblins died getting those supplies from behind enemy lines.

events.summary: Oba says she sent an assassin after Krenko and Kylox was in the way.
events.quote: I sent that assassin after the goblin, and your inventor was standing in his path.

events.summary: Oba declares she may need to kill everyone tempted by the invaders.
events.quote: Maybe cleansing Ravnica from the stains of the invasion means killing every soul who was tempted

events.summary: Oba says she has been killing for weeks and is not finished.
events.quote: I've been killing for weeks

events.summary: Aurelia attempts to arrest Oba, who points out her sisters cannot be held responsible.
events.quote: I formally place you, Oba of Selesnya, under arrest.

events.summary: Oba shakes the room and knocks Aurelia and Proft down.
events.quote: The room shook, not hard, but hard enough to drop Aurelia back to her seat and Detective Proft to the floor.

events.summary: Oba incapacitates her sisters Cim and Ses.
events.quote: Her sisters went limp, sagging on their single trunk like wilted flowers

events.summary: Oba separates from her sisters, ending Trostani as a unified being.
events.quote: Farther and farther from them she pulled herself, until she was, while still attached to the tree itself, an entirely independent entity, Trostani no longer.

events.summary: Thorny vines burst through the walls to seize the guild leaders.
events.quote: Thorny vines burst through the walls, grabbing for the assembled Ravnican leadership.

events.summary: Oba bats aside Ral's lightning and slams him into a bookshelf.
events.quote: a massive branch snapped across the room, slamming into Ral's chest and knocking him into the nearest bookshelf.

events.summary: Massacre Girl slips her chain and disappears.
events.quote: all at once, the assassin was nowhere to be found.

events.summary: Izoni withers the vines binding her with a vial of poison.
events.quote: She sprinkled its contents on the vines and watched dispassionately as they withered and dropped away.

events.summary: Tolsimir intercepts Yarus's charge and is impaled on the rafter.
events.quote: Tolsimir heard the sound and leapt for Yarus, knocking him away from Oba and driving the rafter straight through his own chest.

events.summary: Yarus defies Oba and Etrata takes the root spear meant for him.
events.quote: The spear smashed through the left side of her chest, shattering muscle and bone.

events.summary: Kaya decides Oba must die and Proft kneels by Etrata.
events.quote: after what Oba had admitted, she'd known the dryad had to die.

events.summary: Oba hoists Kaya and Kellan into the air as the ceiling opens.
events.quote: Above them, the ceiling opened like an iris, branches pulling apart to reveal an oblong section of sky.

events.summary: Judith breaks free and flees the collapsing hall.
events.quote: Judith broke free of a loop of root and fled for one of those openings

events.summary: Oba throws Kaya and Kellan, separating them and sending Kellan spinning into the sky.
events.quote: The force of the throw separated her from Kellan, leaving him spinning away into the sky.

events.summary: Kaya realizes Oba is drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul itself.
events.quote: She was drawing directly on the Ravnican Worldsoul, Mat'Selesnya, ripping strength from the very plane and using it against the people she had designated her enemies.

events.summary: Kellan is saved from the fall by gold-rimmed fae magic.
events.quote: pure, gold-rimmed fae magic of the same kind his hilts produced now enveloped him.

events.summary: Massacre Girl intercepts the fleeing Judith and attacks her.
events.quote: This is for leaving me to the wolves

relations.note: her assassin's attack killed the inventor
relations.quote: I sent that assassin after the goblin, and your inventor was standing in his path.
Tolsimir heard the sound and leapt for Yarus, knocking him away from Oba

relations.note: has worked to keep him alive
relations.quote: after I've worked so hard to keep you alive

relations.note: secretly worked with Dimir against the Phyrexians
relations.quote: She was working with House Dimir the whole time
This is for leaving me to the wolves
By the authority given to me as guild leader of the Boros Legion
I have never accepted your authority over me.
